name: SmartRecruiters
tagline: Enterprise talent acquisition REST API for jobs, candidates, and hiring workflows
description: SmartRecruiters provides a mature public REST API for its enterprise talent acquisition platform. Developers can programmatically manage jobs, candidates, applications, and related hiring data. Authentication uses API keys; docs and endpoint details should be verified against current official sources before production use.

auth.details: API key authentication; exact header and signup flow to be confirmed from official docs

pricing.free_tier_limits: Not applicable; no free plan is currently listed.

rate_limits: Customer API: 10 requests/second and 8 concurrent requests per API user. Exceptions: job-publication POST/DELETE endpoints allow 2 requests/second; GET /candidates and the deprecated Analytics API allow 1 concurrent request.
use_cases: list open jobs from a SmartRecruiters company account
fetch candidate application details by ID
create or update job postings programmatically
sync hiring pipeline data into an ATS or HRIS
